title: wk-cdp-placement-verify
desc: Repo-root launcher wk-cdp-placement-verify.ps1 -- verifies Chrome CDP window placement health (on-screen, correct port/PID), part of the gg Main Workflow step 0.75
steps: WHAT: checks currently open CDP-driven Chrome windows for off-screen or failed placement
USAGE: run from repo root as ./wk-cdp-placement-verify.ps1 (bare wk-cdp-placement-verify form once on PATH is pace-exempt) -- exit=0 healthy, exit=1 off-screen/fail, report as gg-status alert
SEE ALSO: standard-chrome-window and cdp-smoke-ci-runbook for placement/CDP internals

requirements.expect: exit 0 when all CDP windows correctly placed

author: claude
